current_flow: composed-relation adds a builder-only composed marker to DomainSpec and, when a governed-financial domain carries it, the SQL builder emits WITH aliased actual/budget CTEs (selecting from the two real rollup views, Actual scoped by its plant='DUB' column, Budget structurally DUB) full-outer-joined on (gl_code, month) with task-2-owned COALESCE zero-fill and objectsTouched listing both view leaves - replacing the multi-gold-object throw. A new governed-financial read action is added to GRANT_ACTIONS, seeded to admin, and enforced at the shared executeResolved boundary together with the domain + selected measure/dimension grants (fail-closed). Freshness / enumeration / scope-validation stay on the real source views and composed reconciliation is deferred (narrowed C1). Hermetic builder/validator/executor-denial tests + a gated D-0008 zero-fill/no-fan-out proof. No warehouse object, no measures/domain (task 3), no endpoint.
new_abstractions: a builder-only DomainSpec.composed marker (sources + joinKeys) that keeps goldObject a real view
the code-composed full-outer Budget-Actual join in the SQL builder (aliased CTEs, in-CTE Actual scope, task-owned COALESCE zero-fill)
a governed-financial read action + fail-closed boundary enforcement of action+domain+measure+dimension grants at executeResolved

criteria_map.a single closed, typed, code-composed fi: KEEP (narrowed, human-decided). The composed relation is the code-composed full-outer join for measure QUERIES; freshness / dimension enumeration / RBAC scope-validation stay on the real source views and composed reconciliation is deferred (measures non-critical). The builder uses aliased CTEs (not view names, no shadowing) selecting from the real views, owns the COALESCE zero-fill, and returns both source view leaves in objectsTouched.
criteria_map.a governed-financial read action is requ: KEEP (amended). The governed-financial read action is enforced at the shared executeResolved boundary together with the domain and every selected measure/dimension grant; scope is inside the Actual CTE (plant='DUB' against the user's validated scope) and Budget is structurally DUB (no plant column). Task 2 seeds only the action grant.
criteria_map.a demonstrated warehouse-DB test proves: KEEP. A gated warehouse-DB test proves correct zero-fill (budget-only and actual-only keys) and no fan-out (a multi-cost-centre GL does not repeat Budget), exact values.

gaps: The proposed composed SQL could not run: each CTE was named after and selected from the same unqualified view (a recursive self-shadow), and the Budget CTE carried a plant predicate although budget_by_gl_month has no plant column.

'Builder-only marker; nothing else changes' contradicted C1's promise to provide relation semantics to freshness, dimension enumeration, RBAC scope-validation and reconciliation: those consumers read only domain.goldObject, so pinning it to Actual would make Budget-only keys invisible and Budget reloads absent from freshness/reconciliation.

The zero-fill / measure interface was unspecified: the builder inserts each measure's expr unchanged, so SUM(actual_net) is NULL for Budget-only groups and raw COALESCE projections conflict with grouped queries; task 3 would have to guess aliases, aggregation and zero-fill ownership.

The grants were sequenced against an absent domain: task 2 excludes baseDomains but asked to seed unnamed domain/measure/dimension grants for an unnamed role, and the migration test (outside write_scope) asserts no such grants exist.

The shared-boundary enforcement checked only the new action, but C2 requires the domain and measure grants too: allowedFor only filters metadata and the executor accepts a supplied domain/selection directly, so a user with the action but without the domain/measure grant could still execute.

The required tests exercised only builder SQL, validator allow-listing and action denial - none proved the promised non-builder relation semantics, so C1 could pass while freshness / Help / scope-validation / reconciliation stayed Actual-only.
resolutions: Use DISTINCT CTE aliases (a/b) selecting from the real rollup views - no view is shadowed - and drop the Budget plant predicate: budget_by_gl_month has no plant column and is structurally DUB-only by construction (0016 single plant). Two-sided scope = the Actual CTE filtered by its plant='DUB' column against the user's validated scope + Budget inherently DUB. objectsTouched lists the two base view leaves; tableList is verified to resolve to those leaves, not the aliases.

HUMAN-decided (round): NARROW C1 to the PoC - the composed relation is the code-composed JOIN that measure QUERIES run; freshness / dimension enumeration / RBAC scope-validation STAY pointed at the real source views (goldObject/freshnessColumn/scopeColumn point at actual_by_gl_month) and composed reconciliation is DEFERRED (governed measures kept non-critical), with a revisit trigger for multi-plant/production. C1's statement is narrowed accordingly; those consumers are not reworked here.

Specified the interface: the two rollups are already one row per (gl_code, month), so the composed relation is a 1:1 full-outer join with NO re-aggregation; COALESCE zero-fill of actual_net/budget_net and the join keys is OWNED by task 2 (the relation), so task-3 measures reference already-0-filled columns and never see NULL - task 3 owns aggregation, task 2 owns zero-fill.

Task 2 seeds ONLY the governed-financial read ACTION grant to role 'admin' (mirroring the ingest grant) and OWNS backend/src/db/migrate.test.ts to update its assertion; the governed-financial domain/measure/dimension grants move to TASK 3 where the domain is registered. The action id and role are named and stable.

Enforce at executeResolved ALL of - the read action, the domain grant, AND a grant for every selected measure and dimension - fail-closed, tested against a FIXTURE governed-financial composed domain (task 2 has no real domain), covering each denial branch plus the fully-granted allow case.

Added the executor authorization tests (each denial branch + the granted-allow case) and explicitly narrowed C1 so freshness / enumeration / scope-validation stay per-source-view and reconciliation is deferred - no composed semantics are required of those surfaces this task.
open_items: Composed-aware freshness / dimension enumeration / RBAC scope-validation / reconciliation deferred (narrowed C1), revisit at multi-plant / production.
The governed-financial domain + Actual/Budget/% measures + their domain/measure/dimension grant seeds are task 3.

rounds.question: composed-relation grill (findings 2 & 6): the criterion promises the composed relation provides 'relation semantics to freshness, dimension enumeration, RBAC scope-validation, and reconciliation.' Those Pulse consumers each read one physical goldObject and issue 'FROM <goldObject>'. Making ALL of them genuinely composed-aware (querying the joined relation) is a materially larger task. For this PoC (single plant DUB; goal = % = Actual÷Budget), how should the composed relation's NON-query surfaces be scoped?
options: Narrow: composed JOIN for queries; defer the rest (Rec.)

summary: One cold read returned six blocking gaps. Five are repository/decision-answerable and resolved in the amended contract + plan: aliased CTEs selecting from the real views with no shadowing and no Budget plant predicate (Budget structurally DUB); the exact zero-fill interface (1:1 join, COALESCE owned by task 2, aggregation by task 3); grants re-sequenced so task 2 seeds only the read action and owns migrate.test while the domain/measure/dimension grants move to task 3; and fail-closed boundary enforcement of action+domain+measure+dimension grants with owned denial tests. One was a genuine scope decision put to the human: NARROW C1 to the composed JOIN for measure queries, leaving freshness/enumeration/scope-validation on the real source views and deferring composed reconciliation. Verdict pass.
